loss: token-level cross-entropy on assistant tokens (note lines and actions); observation tokens and loss-masked spans are not supervised
schedule: linear warmup (3% of steps) then cosine decay
optimizer: AdamW (betas 0.9/0.95, eps 1e-8, weight decay 0), ZeRO-1, fp32 master weights, bf16 autocast
seed: data-order seed d equals the construction draw d of the arm's data
